summary: Iter 93 e2e validation of Plan 2D new features (Métré béton XLSX export, Aciers/ferraillage in descriptif, Assistant IA dialog, PDF lang=fr). Backend pytest 8/8 PASS on /app/backend/tests/test_iter93_plan_beton_acier.py (BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env). GET /api/takeoffs/plan_c56da42f0331/analysis/0?wall_height=2.5 exposes acier_total_kg, acier_poteaux_kg, acier_poutres_kg, acier_dalles_kg, acier_voiles_kg, acier_semelles_kg and acier_ratios={semelles:40,poteaux:130,poutres:140,dalles:85,voiles:60}; the sum matches acier_total_kg (delta<0.2). GET /api/takeoffs/plan_c56da42f0331/structure/0/beton-xlsx?wall_height=2.5&dalle_ep=0.2&voile_ep=0.2 returns 200 application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet with 3 sheets ['Métré béton','Poteaux','Poutres']; unknown plan_id returns 404. POST .../ai-refine returns 400 on empty message, and 200 with {ok, reply, structure} on 'ignore les traits de cote' (IA response respected in ~15-20s, structure preserved on failure per code path). GET /api/documents/{id}/pdf?lang=fr and without lang both return 200 application/pdf on a demo quote. UI Playwright (login demo + /plan?open=plan_c56da42f0331): all data-testids present + visible: structure-ai-assistant, structure-add-footing, structure-add-column, structure-export-beton-xlsx, poteaux-table, poutres-table, descriptif-acier. AI dialog opens ([ai-assistant-dialog]/[ai-assistant-input]/[ai-assistant-send] visible). Clicking [structure-export-beton-xlsx] triggers a real download response 200 openxml. Descriptif chip shows 'Aciers (ferraillage) 21369.4 kg' (poteaux=15, planchers=585.48 m², beton_total=263.07 m³).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL COMPILE BLOCKER (already fixed by tester): 'Identifier aiBusy has already been declared' — duplicate useState [aiBusy,setAiBusy] at L74 (used by runAI 'Lire le plan (IA)') and L1162 (used by chat assistant). Compile failed → the whole /plan page rendered 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Renamed the second one to aiChatBusy (state + 2 JSX usages L3812/L3819). No functional change intended.

action_items: Confirm rename aiBusy → aiChatBusy in PlanTakeoff.jsx (assistant chat) is the intended fix, or refactor differently. Without this fix the whole /plan route was blocked (Webpack overlay).
(mineur) Class-scoped fixture warning in pytest (Pytest 10 deprecation) — not blocking, informational.
critical_code_review_comments: plans_analysis._compute_descriptif exposes ACIER_RATIOS (40/130/140/85/60) via acier_ratios + per-poste acier_*_kg + total — clean and testable.

export_beton_xlsx builds a proper openpyxl Workbook (3 sheets: Métré béton, Poteaux, Poutres) with styled header, 404 on unknown plan, and returns even with zero structure (defensive .get on descriptif) — good.
ai_refine_structure preserves existing structure when refine_structure returns an error and no content (returns ok:false + structure=current) — correct fallback behavior.
PlanTakeoff.jsx is 3943 lines — very large. Should be split (assistant IA dialog, structure tables, export handlers). The duplicated state 'aiBusy' regression is a direct symptom of that size.
documents.document_pdf(doc_id, lang) accepts lang query param; downstream build_document_pdf accepts lang — correctif OK, plus non-régression sans lang.
seed_data_creation: No test data left behind. Backend tests reuse existing plan_c56da42f0331 and reuse an existing quote (creates TEST_ quote only if none exists — none created on demo run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PlanTakeoff.jsx a été renommé aiBusy(assistant) → aiChatBusy pour dédupliquer. Si un futur diff réintroduit deux 'aiBusy', le compile Webpack casse et l'écran affiche 'Compiled with problems' sur /plan. Tests iter93 lisent BASE_URL depuis /app/frontend/.env (env var pas exposée dans pytest). Endpoint list plans = GET /api/takeoffs → {plans:[...]}, docs = GET /api/documents → {documents:[...]}. AI refine peut prendre 15-30s (Gemini).
rca of the issue: PlanTakeoff.jsx contenait deux useState avec le même nom aiBusy: une déclarée en haut pour le bouton 'Lire le plan (IA)' (runAI) et une seconde ajoutée dans le bloc Assistant IA. JavaScript strict/Babel refuse la redéclaration dans le même scope → SyntaxError → build KO → overlay 'Compiled with problems' bloquant l'accès entier à /plan. Correction appliquée: renommage second aiBusy en aiChatBusy (état + 2 usages JSX) — un identifiant clair et sans collision.
